Process Flow

Service Selector

The Service dropdown lists all registered CCL web services. Select a service to load its parameter form.

  • Program name is the actual CCL program that will be called
  • Description explains what data the service returns

Parameters

Each service defines positional parameters. The form renders the appropriate input for each one.

Field Types

TypeDescription
TextFree-text input. Type any string value.
SelectDropdown with predefined options.
DateTimeDate and time picker. Quick presets available (Today Start, Yesterday Start, Now).
DateDate-only picker with presets.
TimeTime-only picker with presets.
NumberNumeric input. Sent unquoted to CCL (no ^caret^ wrapping).
HiddenNot shown in the form. Uses its default value automatically.

Required vs Optional

  • Fields marked with a red * are required
  • Optional fields can be left empty — sent as ^^ (empty carets) to CCL
  • Default values are pre-populated from the parameter library or service definition

How Parameters Are Sent

In Raw mode, parameters are assembled into a positional string:

^MINE^,^ClinicalDoc^,^^,^CMC^,^19-MAR-2026 00:00:00^
  • String values are wrapped in ^carets^
  • Numeric values are sent bare: 1 not ^1^
  • Empty optional parameters are sent as ^^
  • Order matters — parameters are sorted by position number

In Clinical Office mode, parameters are sent as named key-value pairs.

Execution Modes

Raw Mode

Uses the native XMLCclRequest object in PowerChart. Sends the positional parameter string exactly as CCL expects it.

Use Raw mode when:

  • Testing any CCL script for the first time
  • You need exact control over the parameter string
  • The CCL script was written for positional prompt invocation

Clinical Office Mode

Uses the Clinical Office CustomService framework with automatic JSON parsing, error handling, and Reference Service support.

Use Clinical Office mode when:

  • You want to collect Reference Service metadata about response fields
  • The CCL script supports Clinical Office named parameter mapping
  • You need patient context binding (personId/encntrId)

Note: The Clinical Office button is disabled if the framework is not initialized.

Include Reference

When checked (Clinical Office mode only), adds reference: true to the payload. This tells the CCL script to return metadata about its fields. Reference data appears in the MPage log.

Load Reference Button

Loads Reference Service data for all built-in services (Address, Allergy, Diagnosis, etc.). Results are logged to the MPage Log panel at the bottom of the screen. Does not affect normal execution.

Results Panel

Status Indicators

  • Success (green) — CCL script returned data successfully
  • Failed (red) — An error occurred

JSON Viewer Modes

ModeDescription
TreeInteractive expandable tree view. Search and copy paths.
CodeSyntax-highlighted raw JSON. Best for copying the full response.
TableAuto-detects arrays and renders as tables. Nested arrays are expandable.

History

Click History to open the execution history drawer (last 50 executions).

  • Green dot = successful execution
  • Red dot = failed execution
  • Mode badge = "Raw" or "CO"
  • Click any entry to reload its result
